notes: Unmodified original source artifacts are preserved; TAP files use deterministic gzip.
Counts are recorded per artifact, not summed as independent distinct tests.
Failed, cancelled, invalid-identity, withdrawn-code and test-oracle results are retained.
No checkout, dependency tree, database, WAL, SHM, raw credential or permit key is copied.
Only concluded weekly functional run may be archived; an in-progress log is excluded.
